verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad public API surface: Locations, Catalog, Inventory, Orders, Disputes, Payouts and Terminal APIs. It also offers an official TypeScript SDK with payment-creation examples, a public API specification repo, webhooks, a test sandbox and an llms.txt index, so the product can be driven programmatically. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of API use, and an OpenAPI spec at a discoverable developer-site path (all probed paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Learn how to use a Square API to update and retrieve location information for a Square seller.
The Square TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Square APIs from TypeScript.
